words.root_logic: ob-（挡在前）+ struct（垒）→ 在通路上垒起东西 → 堵住
words.origin: 拉丁语 obstruere（堵塞），来自 ob（对面、挡）＋struere（堆叠）
words.native_definition: to block a path or prevent something from happening
words.core_concept: piling something up across the way so nothing gets through – 在通路上垒起一堆，谁也过不去
words.core_image: 巷口垒起半人高的砖，车马到此只能折返
examples: A fallen tree obstructed the road.
He was charged with obstructing justice.
semantic_expansions: 阻塞/阻碍：在通路上垒起东西、使过不去
words.recall_hint: ob-（挡在前）+ struct（垒）→ 在路上垒起一堆

words.root_logic: obstruct（垒起挡路）+ -ion → 挡路这件事，或挡路的那个东西
words.origin: 拉丁语 obstructio，来自 obstruere ← ob＋struere
words.native_definition: something that blocks a way; the act of blocking
words.core_concept: the pile that stands across the way, and the placing of it – 横在路上的那一堆，及垒它这件事
words.core_image: 清障车开来，把横在道中的那一堆一点点搬开
examples: Remove any obstruction from the pipe.
semantic_expansions: 障碍物：横在路上的那一堆
阻碍/妨碍：垒起它、使人过不去这件事
words.recall_hint: obstruct（垒起挡路）+ -ion → 挡路之物与其事

words.root_logic: infra-（在下）+ structure（垒起之物）→ 垒在底下托住上面的那一套
words.origin: 英语 infrastructure，由拉丁 infra（在下）＋structura（构造）← struere 合成
words.native_definition: the basic systems such as roads and power that a country needs
words.core_concept: what is built underneath to hold everything else up – 垒在底下、托住上面全部的那一层
words.core_image: 路面之下埋着管线与地基，上面的楼才立得住
semantic_expansions: 基础设施/基础架构：垒在底下托住上层全部的那一套
words.recall_hint: infra-（在下）+ structure（垒起之物）→ 垒在底下托住上面

words.root_logic: elektr（琥珀）+ -on（粒）→ 带那种「琥珀之力」的最小粒
words.origin: 英语 electron，1891 年由 electric＋-on 造出；electric ← 希腊语 elektron（琥珀），琥珀摩擦后能吸引轻物，电现象由此得名
words.native_definition: a very small particle carrying a negative charge
words.core_concept: the smallest bearer of the force amber showed when rubbed – 琥珀摩擦所显那股力的最小承载者
words.core_image: 琥珀在布上擦几下，碎纸屑就往它上头扑
examples: The beam is a stream of electrons.
semantic_expansions: 电子：带负电、体积极小的那种粒子
words.recall_hint: elektr（琥珀）+ -on（粒）→ 带琥珀之力的最小粒

words.root_logic: electron（电子）+ -ic（…的）→ 靠电子工作的
words.origin: 英语 electronic，来自 electron ← 希腊语 elektron（琥珀）
words.native_definition: using or relating to devices that work by controlling electrons
words.core_concept: working by steering those smallest bearers of charge – 靠驾驭那些最小带电粒来运作
words.core_image: 板子上细如发丝的线路一通，屏就亮了
semantic_expansions: 电子的/电子化的：靠驾驭电子来运作的
words.recall_hint: electron（电子）+ -ic → 靠电子工作的

words.root_logic: tribuere（分给、缴纳）→ 按份缴上去的那笔 → 贡赋；引申为致敬之礼
words.origin: 拉丁语 tributum（贡赋），来自 tribuere（分配、缴纳）
words.native_definition: something said or given to show respect; a payment made by one state to another
words.core_concept: the share handed up in acknowledgement – 按份呈上去、表示认这份情的东西
words.core_image: 各家按份把谷物送到城门，一车车登记入册
examples: The concert was a tribute to her teacher.
The city paid tribute to the empire.
semantic_expansions: 贡品：按份呈上去的那笔
致敬/颂词：把心意按份呈上，同一个「奉上」动作
words.recall_hint: tribuere（分给、缴纳）→ 按份呈上去的东西

words.root_logic: con-（一同）+ tribut（分给）+ -ion → 各人拿出自己那份凑到一处
words.origin: 拉丁语 contributio，来自 contribuere（共同出资）← con＋tribuere
words.native_definition: something given to help achieve something; a payment to a common fund
words.core_concept: each hand putting its share into the same pile – 各人把自己那份放进同一堆里
words.core_image: 桌上那只匣子，来的人各投一份进去
examples: He made a small contribution to the fund.
semantic_expansions: 贡献：拿出自己那份凑到共同一处
捐款/投稿：同一动作用在钱或文稿上
words.recall_hint: con-（一同）+ tribut（分给）→ 各出一份凑到一处

words.root_logic: hospit（待客）+ -al → 本指收留旅人之所，后专指收治病人的地方
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 hospitale（客舍、济贫院），来自 hospes（主/客）；hospes 与 hostis 同出原始印欧语 *ghos-ti-，本族收待客那一支
words.native_definition: a place where sick or injured people are treated
words.core_concept: the house that takes in whoever arrives needing care – 接纳前来求治者的那处屋舍
words.core_image: 门开着，抬进来的人一个个被接下、安置到床位上
examples: She was taken to hospital by ambulance.
He works at the city hospital.
semantic_expansions: 医院：本为收留旅人之所，后专指收治病人的地方
words.recall_hint: hospit（待客）+ -al → 接纳来者的那处屋舍

words.root_logic: hospit（待客）+ -ality → 待客这件事、那份周到
words.origin: 拉丁语 hospitalitas（好客），来自 hospes（主/客）← *ghos-ti-
words.native_definition: friendly and generous treatment of guests
words.core_concept: the care put into receiving whoever comes – 接待来者时使出的那份周到
words.core_image: 客人一进门，茶水与坐处都已备下
examples: The hotel is known for its hospitality.
semantic_expansions: 好客/招待/款待：接待来者时使出的那份周到
words.recall_hint: hospit（待客）+ -ality → 待客那份周到

words.root_logic: consuetudo（成例、惯常）→ 一地惯常的穿戴 → 服装、戏装
words.origin: 法语 costume，来自意大利语 costume（习俗、装束）← 拉丁语 consuetudo（惯常）；与 custom 同源，一支走「习俗」义，一支走「装束」义
words.native_definition: clothes worn to look like someone else, or typical of a place or period
words.core_concept: what a place has long been in the habit of wearing – 一地长年惯常穿戴的那一套
words.core_image: 戏班箱子里那几套按老样式裁的衣裳，年年照旧
examples: The dancers appeared in traditional costume.
semantic_expansions: 服装/民族服装：一地惯常穿戴的那一套
戏装：照旧样式备下、供扮演穿的那身
words.recall_hint: consuetudo（成例）→ 惯常的穿戴 → 服装

words.root_logic: ac-（ad- 朝）+ custom（成例）+ -ed → 已入成例的 → 习惯了的
words.origin: 英语 accustomed，来自 accustom ← 古法语 acostumer ← 拉丁语 consuetudo
words.native_definition: familiar with something through long experience; usual
words.core_concept: worn into the groove until it feels ordinary – 走顺了那道沟，做起来不觉费力
words.core_image: 同一条路走了几十年，脚自己知道往哪拐
examples: She is accustomed to early starts.
semantic_expansions: 习惯的/惯常的：已走顺那道沟、做来不觉费力
words.recall_hint: ac-（朝）+ custom（成例）+ -ed → 已入成例的

words.root_logic: re-（再）+ present（放到眼前）→ 再把它摆到眼前 → 代表、表现
words.origin: 拉丁语 repraesentare（再现、呈现），来自 re＋praesentare ← praesens ← praeesse
words.native_definition: to act on behalf of someone; to stand for or depict something
words.core_concept: putting a thing before the eyes again in another's stead – 替某方再把它摆到眼前
words.core_image: 他替全村上台开口，村里人虽不在场，话却在场
examples: This graph represents last year's sales.
semantic_expansions: 代表：替某方把其意再摆到眼前
表现/象征：把事物再呈到眼前来指代它
words.recall_hint: re-（再）+ present（放到眼前）→ 替人再摆到眼前

words.root_logic: represent（代表）+ -ative → 受托来代表的那个人或物
words.origin: 英语 representative，来自 represent ← 拉丁语 repraesentare ← praeesse
words.native_definition: a person chosen to act or speak for others; typical of a group
words.core_concept: the one sent to stand before others in their stead – 被派去替众人站到台前的那个
words.core_image: 各车间推一个人出来，那人往台前一站，说的是全班的意思
examples: This sample is representative of the whole.
semantic_expansions: 代表/代理人：受托替众人站到台前的那个
有代表性的：拿它就能指代整体的
words.recall_hint: represent（代表）+ -ative → 受托代表的那个

words.root_logic: temper（调和、按分寸）+ -ature → 冷热调到什么分寸 → 温度
words.origin: 拉丁语 temperatura（调和之度），来自 temperare（调和、节制）← tempus；本族已收 temper/temporary/contemporary，此词走「调和分寸」那一支
words.native_definition: how hot or cold something is, measured on a scale
words.core_concept: where the hot and cold have been brought into balance – 冷与热调停到的那个位置
words.core_image: 壶里兑进一瓢凉水，手伸进去正好不烫
examples: His temperature is back to normal.
semantic_expansions: 温度/气温：冷热调停到的那个位置
体温：人身上那个位置的读数
words.recall_hint: temper（调和分寸）+ -ature → 冷热调到的那个度

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ strain（拉紧）+ -t → 往回收紧这件事 → 克制、约束
words.origin: 古法语 restrainte，来自 restringere（拉回束紧）← re＋stringere（拉紧）
words.native_definition: control over one's own behaviour; a limit placed on someone
words.core_concept: the cord pulled back to check what was about to move – 往回一拽、把正要动的收住那股力
words.core_image: 话到嘴边被自己拽回去，脸上一点没露
examples: New restraints were placed on spending.
semantic_expansions: 克制：把自己往回拽住那份力
约束/限制措施：外加的那道收紧
words.recall_hint: re-（往回）+ strain（拉紧）→ 往回收住那股力

words.root_logic: ac-（ad- 落到…上）+ cid（落下）+ -ent → 落到人头上的那一桩 → 意外
words.origin: 拉丁语 accidens（偶然发生的），来自 accidere（落到、发生）← ad＋cadere（落下）；与 incident 同族。拼写含 ident 只是巧合，与 idem（同一个）无关
words.native_definition: an unexpected event that causes damage or injury
words.core_concept: the thing that came down on one without being asked – 没招呼一声就落到人头上的那一桩
words.core_image: 拐角处一声闷响，两辆车谁也没料到会撞上
examples: He was hurt in a car accident.
They met by accident at the station.
semantic_expansions: 事故/意外：没打招呼就落到头上的那一桩
偶然：并非安排、恰好落下的
words.recall_hint: ac-（落到上）+ cid（落下）→ 落到人头上的那一桩

words.root_logic: accident（落下之事）+ -al（…的）→ 属于偶然落下的 → 无意的
words.origin: 英语 accidental，来自 accident ← accidere ← ad＋cadere
words.native_definition: happening by chance and not on purpose
words.core_concept: of the kind that just came down, not aimed – 属于恰好落下、并非瞄准的那种
words.core_image: 手一滑那杯子就掉了，谁也不是有意的
semantic_expansions: 偶然的/意外的：恰好落下、并非瞄准的
无意的：落下时本无此心
words.recall_hint: accident（落下之事）+ -al → 属于恰好落下的

words.root_logic: e-（ex- 出来）+ vid（看）+ -ent → 明摆在外看得见的 → 显然
words.origin: 拉丁语 evidens（明显的），来自 e＋videre（看）；拼写含 ident 只是巧合，与 idem（同一个）无关
words.native_definition: clear to see or understand; obvious
words.core_concept: standing out where the eye cannot miss it – 摆在外头，眼睛想漏也漏不掉
words.core_image: 地上那道湿痕一直连到门口，谁进过屋一看便知
examples: It was evident that she was tired.
His skill is evident in every line.
semantic_expansions: 明显的/显然的：明摆在外、眼睛漏不掉的
words.recall_hint: e-（出来）+ vid（看）→ 明摆在外看得见的

words.root_logic: extra-（出乎…之外）+ ordinary（常序）→ 跳出常序之外的 → 非凡
words.origin: 拉丁语 extraordinarius（不合常规的），来自 extra ordinem（在常序之外）← ordo
words.native_definition: very unusual or remarkable; beyond what is ordinary
words.core_concept: the one that falls outside the row everything else stands in – 从众物所立那一列里跳出去的
words.core_image: 一排都齐着，只有那一个高出一头，站在队形之外
semantic_expansions: 非凡的/特别的：跳出常序、不在那一列里
异常的：同样偏离常规那一档
words.recall_hint: extra-（之外）+ ordinary（常序）→ 跳出常序之外

words.root_logic: punct（刺出的点）+ -ual → 正落在那个点上的 → 准时
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 punctualis（准于一点的），来自 punctum（刺出的点）
words.native_definition: arriving or happening at exactly the right time
words.core_concept: landing exactly on the marked spot, not beside it – 正落在标出的那一点上，不偏旁边
words.core_image: 针尖落下正压在刻度那一道上，分毫不差
examples: He is always punctual for class.
semantic_expansions: 准时的/守时的：正落在标定那一点上、不偏不错
words.recall_hint: punct（刺点）+ -ual → 正落在那一点上

words.root_logic: dis-（取消）+ appoint（点定）→ 把点定好的那件事撤掉 → 使失望
words.origin: 古法语 desapointier（免职、取消约定），由 des-＋apointier ← punctum（点）
words.native_definition: to make someone sad by failing to do what they hoped
words.core_concept: undoing what had been pinned to a point, leaving it empty – 把钉在那点上的事撤掉，那儿就空了
words.core_image: 约好的那一格被划掉，人白等了一下午
semantic_expansions: 使失望/使扫兴：把点定好的事撤掉，留下空处
words.recall_hint: dis-（取消）+ appoint（点定）→ 把定好的撤掉

words.root_logic: gener（族类）+ -al + -ize → 由个别推到整族 → 概括、一概而论
words.origin: 英语 generalize，来自 general ← 拉丁语 generalis（属于全族的）← genus（族类）
words.native_definition: to draw a broad conclusion from particular cases
words.core_concept: taking what one case showed and laying it over the whole kin – 把一例所见铺到整族头上
words.core_image: 看了三只都是白的，便说这一族都白
examples: Do not generalize from one example.
semantic_expansions: 概括/归纳：由个别推及整族
一概而论：铺得过头、不分个别的那种推法
words.recall_hint: gener（族类）+ -ize → 由个别推到整族

words.root_logic: gener（生出）+ -ator（施为者）→ 使某物生出来的那件机器
words.origin: 拉丁语 generator（生育者、产生者），来自 generare（生出）← genus
words.native_definition: a machine that produces electricity or other output
words.core_concept: the thing that brings a supply into being – 使某样东西源源生出来的那件器械
words.core_image: 机器一响，原本没有的电就源源出来了
examples: The hospital has a backup generator.
This tool is a code generator.
semantic_expansions: 发电机/发生器：使某物源源生出来的那件器械
words.recall_hint: gener（生出）+ -ator → 使之生出的那件机器

words.root_logic: pro-（往前）+ secut（跟随）→ 一路追到底 → 起诉、依法追究
words.origin: 拉丁语 prosecutus，prosequi（追随到底）的过去分词 ← pro＋sequi（跟随）
words.native_definition: to bring a legal case against someone in court
words.core_concept: following a matter all the way through to its end – 咬住一桩事一路跟到底
words.core_image: 案卷一层层往上递，一路跟到判下来为止
examples: They prosecuted the case for two years.
semantic_expansions: 起诉/检举：依法咬住一桩事追到底
彻底进行：同一个「跟到底」用在做事上
words.recall_hint: pro-（往前）+ secut（跟随）→ 一路追到底

words.root_logic: per-（一路、不断）+ secut（跟随）→ 不断追着为难 → 迫害
words.origin: 拉丁语 persecutus，persequi（追逼）的过去分词 ← per＋sequi（跟随）
words.native_definition: to treat someone cruelly over time, especially for their beliefs
words.core_concept: keeping after a person without ever letting up – 一路追着不放、不给对方喘息
words.core_image: 那家人搬到哪儿，后头的人就跟到哪儿，一年没断过
examples: They were persecuted for their faith.
He felt persecuted by the press.
semantic_expansions: 迫害/折磨：一路追着不放、不给喘息
words.recall_hint: per-（不断）+ secut（跟随）→ 追着不放

words.root_logic: class（同一等第）+ mate（伙伴）→ 被编在同一班的伙伴
words.origin: 英语复合词 class＋mate；class ← 拉丁语 classis（等第、编组）
words.native_definition: a person in the same class at school
words.core_concept: one sorted into the same bracket as oneself – 与自己被编进同一格的那个人
words.core_image: 点名册上两个名字挨着，从开学起就坐一排
examples: She met her old classmate downtown.
semantic_expansions: 同班同学：与自己被编进同一格的人
words.recall_hint: class（同一等第）+ mate（伙伴）→ 同格的伙伴

words.root_logic: class（编组）+ room（屋）→ 一编人一起上课的那间屋
words.origin: 英语复合词 class＋room；class ← 拉丁语 classis（等第、编组）
words.native_definition: a room in a school where lessons are taught
words.core_concept: the room a whole bracket of learners sits in – 同编的一群人共坐的那间屋
words.core_image: 推门进去，桌椅一排排冲着黑板
examples: She stayed in the classroom after school.
semantic_expansions: 教室：同编一群人一起上课的那间屋
words.recall_hint: class（编组）+ room（屋）→ 同编者共坐的屋

words.root_logic: as-（ad- 朝）+ sumpt（取）+ -ion → 先取来当真的那一条 → 假定
words.origin: 拉丁语 assumptio（取用、采纳），来自 assumere（取来）← ad＋sumere（取）
words.native_definition: something believed true without proof; the act of taking on
words.core_concept: the piece one picks up and treats as given before checking – 未及核就先拿来当真的那一条
words.core_image: 他没查底册，先拿一条当真，往下全按这条推
examples: His assumption of office was swift.
semantic_expansions: 假定/假设：未核就先取来当真的那一条
承担：把职责取到自己身上
words.recall_hint: as-（朝）+ sumpt（取）→ 先取来当真的那条

words.root_logic: con-（尽）+ sumpt（取用）+ -ion → 取用到尽 → 消耗、消费
words.origin: 拉丁语 consumptio（耗尽），来自 consumere（用尽）← con＋sumere（取）
words.native_definition: the using up of resources; the amount used
words.core_concept: taking from the store until it is spent – 一直从堆里取，取到见底
words.core_image: 油表的针一路往左掉，箱里那些一趟就见了底
semantic_expansions: 消耗/消费：取用到尽的那个量与过程
食用：同一个「取入」用在饮食上
words.recall_hint: con-（尽）+ sumpt（取用）→ 取用到见底

words.root_logic: re-（彻底）+ solut（解开）+ -ion → 把缠住的彻底解开 → 决心、解决、决议
words.origin: 拉丁语 resolutio（解开、分解），来自 resolvere（解开）← re＋solvere
words.native_definition: a firm decision; the solving of a problem; a formal vote of a body
words.core_concept: the knot worked loose so the line runs free again – 缠住的那个结被解开，绳又顺了
words.core_image: 缠了半天的那个结终于松开，线一抽就顺了
examples: She made a New Year resolution.
semantic_expansions: 决心：心里犹疑的结被解开、定住
解决：把缠住的难处解开
决议：会上表决定下的那一条

words.root_logic: re-（彻底）+ solut（解开）→ 犹疑已解开、心里定住的 → 坚决
words.origin: 拉丁语 resolutus，resolvere（解开）的过去分词 ← re＋solvere
words.native_definition: showing firm determination; not wavering
words.core_concept: with the hesitation already untied, nothing left pulling back – 犹疑那道结已解开，再没什么往回拽
words.core_image: 他不再来回踱步，抬头说出那句话时脚跟没动
examples: She was resolute in her refusal.
semantic_expansions: 坚决的/果断的：犹疑已解开、心里定住不再摇

words.root_logic: relat（带回、关联）+ -ive → 得带回来比着看的 → 相对的；名词指亲属
words.origin: 拉丁语 relativus（有关联的），来自 relatus（referre 的过去分词）← re＋ferre（带）
words.native_definition: considered in comparison with something else; a member of one's family
words.core_concept: only meaningful when carried back and set beside another – 非得带回来与另一个并着看才有意义
words.core_image: 单说这块高不算数，把它搬到那块旁边一比才知道
semantic_expansions: 相对的：须带回来与他物并比才有意义
相关的：两者之间有可带回的联系
亲属：与自己有血缘关联的人
words.recall_hint: relat（带回关联）+ -ive → 须并着比才算数

words.root_logic: relative（相对的）+ -ity → 相对这个性质；物理学上专指该理论
words.origin: 英语 relativity，来自 relative ← 拉丁语 relatus ← re＋ferre
words.native_definition: the state of being relative; Einstein's theory of space and time
words.core_concept: the fact that a measure holds only against some other – 一个量非得对着另一个才立得住
words.core_image: 在车里看是静的，站在路边看却在动，得说明对着谁量
examples: The theory of relativity changed physics.
He wrote on the relativity of morals.
semantic_expansions: 相对性：量非得对着另一个才立得住
相对论：以此为核心的那套物理理论
words.recall_hint: relative（相对的）+ -ity → 须对着他物才立得住

words.root_logic: habitat（它居住）→ 某种生物惯常住的那片地方
words.origin: 拉丁语 habitat（它居住），habitare（居住）的第三人称现在式；旧时物种志用此词起头标注产地，遂成名词
words.native_definition: the natural home of an animal or plant
words.core_concept: the place a living thing keeps returning to dwell in – 某种活物一代代回来住下的那片地方
words.core_image: 同一片湿地，那群鸟年年回来筑巢
examples: The marsh is a habitat for rare birds.
semantic_expansions: 栖息地/生境：某种活物惯常回来住下的那片地方
words.recall_hint: habitat（它居住）→ 惯常住下的那片地方

words.root_logic: mod（量度、时式）+ -ern → 合当下这一档时式的 → 现代的
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 modernus（当今的），来自 modo（just now）← modus（量度、方式）
words.native_definition: belonging to the present time; up to date
words.core_concept: cut to the measure the present moment uses – 按眼下这一档尺度裁出来的
words.core_image: 屋里陈设照当下的样式换过一轮，旧的一件没留
semantic_expansions: 现代的/近代的：按眼下这一档时式裁出来的
新式的：同一档上属新的那一头
words.recall_hint: mod（时式）+ -ern → 合当下这档时式的

words.root_logic: modern（现代的）+ -ization → 把旧的改到当下这一档 → 现代化
words.origin: 英语 modernization，来自 modernize ← modern ← 拉丁语 modus
words.native_definition: the process of making something suit present-day needs
words.core_concept: refitting the old thing to the measure now in use – 把旧的一样样改到眼下通行那一档
words.core_image: 老厂房一间间翻修，机器照新标准换过
semantic_expansions: 现代化/更新：把旧的改到眼下通行那一档
words.recall_hint: modern（现代的）+ -ization → 改到当下这一档
